description: Run pinned kicad-happy PCB checks. The associated schematic is discovered automatically and used for PCB enrichment and cross-domain checks. Thermal and EMC are opt-in. Analysis instructions: /scratch/pkg/node_modules/kicad-copilot-mcp/docs/analysis.md

all.description: Return all optional PCB fields and run thermal and EMC. Does not override findings=false or enable proximity.

assembly.description: Return fiducials, orientation, test points, silkscreen, tombstoning, via-in-pad, and assembly complexity.

buses.description: Return bus and differential-pair routing information enriched from the schematic.

connectivity.description: Return copper connectivity, disconnected islands, plane splits, and zone continuity.

cross.description: Return detailed schematic/PCB cross-domain analysis. Cross checks run automatically when a schematic exists.

dfm.description: Return fabrication process tier, rule compliance, manufacturing metrics, and DFM issues.

emc.description: Run analytical EMC pre-compliance checks and return risk score, categories, and test plan. SPICE is not used.

findings.description: Return merged PCB, cross, thermal, and EMC findings. Disable for focused report-only queries.

overview.description: Return board dimensions, layers, footprints, copper counts, zones, and routing completion.

path.description: Path to a .kicad_pcb, .kicad_pro, or KiCad project directory.

placement.description: Return placement density, component groups, courtyard/edge issues, and decoupling distances.

power.description: Return power routing, current capacity, ground domains, decoupling proximity, and switching loops.

proximity.description: Enable slower trace proximity and crosstalk analysis after routing exists.

routing.description: Return compact track/via distributions, net lengths, layer transitions, and proximity results.

schematic.description: Optional root .kicad_sch override. Normally discovered from the PCB/project automatically.

thermal.description: Run thermal analysis and return junction-temperature, margin, proximity, and thermal-via results.

name: analyze_pcb
title: Analyze KiCad PCB
